_comment: Open roles shown on careers.html. Delete a role to remove it from the site; set an empty list to show the 'no openings' message. If Breathe HR turns out to expose a vacancy endpoint, careers.js can read that instead without the page changing.

roles.title: Warehouse & Despatch Assistant
roles.summary: Picking, packing and despatching customer orders accurately and on time.
responsibilities: Pick and pack orders ready for despatch
Keep stock tidy, counted and where it should be
Book parcels in with couriers and track despatches
Check returned items and log their condition
requirements: Careful and organised — the right item, in the right box, every time
Comfortable lifting and on your feet for much of the day
Right to work in the UK
